digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend adapter seam; Jira family abstraction layer
propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to record the jira_family sub-seam layer, its two parameterizing contracts, and the shared-jira provenance decision deferring generalization to the GitHub adapter epic.

The backend contract suite's certification claim is conditional on port completeness and typed parameters; the DC transport declared six TicketTransport members while the core reaches for twenty-one distinct members, with twelve absent and causing silent failures.
RemoteRef.instance is never constructed in production code and must be documented as intended design with its implementation gap named and tracked, not as existing reality.
The jira_family seam is a deliberately time-boxed investment ending with DC read-only on 28 March 2029, making the durable asset the family seam architecture rather than the DC adapter itself.
The documented user-guide commands for selecting and installing the DC backend must be executable against a real Jira Data Center instance with proper configuration surface coverage.
Operator documentation must specify least-privilege PAT scoping, cleartext-only allow_insecure usage, ca_bundle configuration for internal CAs, and resolved_statuses for non-standard workflows.
